title: Weight Loss Tracker Google Sheets, Weigh In Log, 7 Day Average Chart, Body Measurement Tracker, Weight Loss Journal for Phone
desc:
Weigh in, type one number, done. A calm weight loss tracker in Google Sheets: the dates are already filled in, your 7-day average shows the real trend, and every size change is worked out for you.

You get a PDF with links to your own Google Sheet: a blank copy and a filled-in example. Log on your phone in the free Google Sheets app, then see the big picture on a laptop. Not for Excel or Numbers, and not a printable.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD: open the PDF, tap the link and press "Make a copy". Nothing is shipped.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start Here: set up in 3 easy steps
• Setup: lb or kg, inches or centimetres, start date, start weight, an optional goal and up to 10 body parts (rename any)
• Today (phone): one button to log today's weight, plus your latest weight, 7-day average, change since you started, goal progress, a 30-day trend line, weekly streak, sizes and your next badge
• Weigh-ins: one row per day, dates already filled in. Type your weight; the change and 7-day average fill in. Tick a box when you take a progress photo and add a note if you like
• Measure: one row per check-in, the date fills itself in, and the change since your first check-in is shown for every body part
• Weekly Review: days weighed, weekly average and change worked out for you. Rate the week, set one focus and tick Done
• Milestones: 25 badges, each showing the day you earned it, levels and XP for logging, and your own rewards list
• Dashboard (laptop): pick Since start, 12, 4 or 2 weeks and everything updates. Four summary cards with mini charts (latest weight and goal, change, weigh-ins, sizes), a weight trend chart with your 7-day average and goal line, a ring showing where the inches went, every size first vs latest, your week by week, six key checks with On track / Check chips, and a Needs attention list with one-tap links
• More from Kova: our other trackers

WHY IT KEEPS YOU GOING
• One number a day. No calorie counting, no food logging
• Up a little today? The 7-day average shows the real trend
• A weekly streak that freezes when you miss a week, instead of resetting (two missed weeks in a row start it again)
• Badges and levels reward logging and showing up, never a number on the scales
• "Go to today" and "Log today's weight" jump straight to today's row, so there's no scrolling

GOOD TO KNOW
• You need a free Google account
• A logging tool, not medical advice
• For personal use only. Please don't share or resell the file or links
• Digital file, so no returns, but message us if anything doesn't work and we'll help
